plans.idea: Classic banner split like the original: logo, two-line headline and CTA stacked on a shared left edge, with the phone and the warm photo tile grouped together on the right so the imagery reads as one block.

Three-column left-to-right read: the imagery (photo tile and full-height phone) opens on the left, the headline holds the centre, and the brand sign-off column on the right pairs the logo with the CTA.

Bookended composition: the warm photo tile anchors the left, the logo and headline sit together in a wide central block, and the phone with the CTA beside it closes the right end, so the product leads straight into the action.
